name: Junction Platform Project pipelines
monitor_reason: length: two separate lines of about 10 mi (16 km) each, 30 in and 12 in; neither reaches 25 km (15.5 mi) on its own, and the combined 19.5 to 20 mi (about 31 km) serves two different connections
researcher_notes: Discovery Gas Transmission LLC, FERC docket CP12-516, filed September 2012. Federal Register notice and a FERC application summary describe a new platform in South Timbalier block 283, about 10 miles of 30 inch pipe to Discovery's mainline in Ewing Banks block 873, and about 10 miles of 12 inch pipe to Sea Robin's system in South Timbalier block 280. EIA lists it as Completed in 2015, 20 miles, 405 MMcf/d, cost 126 million dollars. No existing GEM row matches under another name; the only junction-named row, P7810, is an unrelated Gulf South project. The project is already built, so it is not a new announcement. Under the 25 km length rule each line is too short. Offshore Gulf of Mexico, no state. Not matched to any existing row.
